Thanks, Scott — welcome aboard. Short version: we need a completed vendor onboarding form, current COI that meets the minimum limits below, a W-9 (US entities), and bank remit details for PO/payment setup. I attached our procurement checklist for reference.

Minimum insurance requirements (for vendor activation / PO issuance):
- Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
- Business Auto Liability: $1,000,000 combined single limit (if US vehicles involved)
- Professional / Technology / Cyber Liability: $2,000,000 (or proof of equivalent E&O + cyber)
- Employer's Liability/Workers' Comp: statutory limits
- Umbrella/Excess: $2,000,000 recommended (not always required)

Endorsements we require for most integrations:
- Additional Insured (CG 20 10 or equivalent) on General Liability naming "Redwood Inference, Inc."
- Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood (if vendor's carrier allows)
- Primary and Non-Contributory wording for the Additional Insured endorsement

Certificate holder: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Address: 1201 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103

We can accept emailed COIs for initial review; final activation requires either the certificate attached to your vendor profile in our procurement portal or the insurer-uploaded evidence. If you can't get the exact endorsement text, send the COI now and we'll review immediate gaps. For now, we'll proceed with conditional PO steps if COI and W-9 are provided.

PO terms and billing notes:
- Standard net terms: Net 45 after invoice receipt (exceptions possible with Finance approval)
- Billing email: AP@openchip.io (confirm if different)
- Please indicate the invoice remit-to and whether your invoices will reference a PO number

Next steps:
1) Send completed onboarding form (I attached our template).
2) Attach COI and W-9. If COI lacks endorsements, indicate ETA for insurer endorsement.
3) Complete the bank details sheet for payment.

If you want me to fast-track a conditional PO to unblock initial work while we wait for cyber coverage endorsement, I can loop in Marissa and Iris to provision a conditional activation.

Dylan
Sr. Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
